supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 made repeated connections to the explicit proxy at roughly five-minute intervals during much of the alert window: 13:30:03, 13:36:22, 13:41:10, 13:46:34, 13:51:47, 13:55:57, 14:01:14, and 14:06:22 UTC.
These records identify the destination as the internal proxy, 10.30.20.30:8080, but do not identify the external HTTPS host or the initiating process for the recurring connections.

The inventory describes ChartMate Imaging as checking for updates about every five minutes, which is consistent with the cadence, but the available records do not tie these connections to cmupdate.exe or to the approved update domain.

Near the end of the alert window, OneDrive started and Chrome accessed SharePoint; this provides benign context for activity around 14:10 but does not establish the destination or purpose of the earlier recurring connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The recurring-flow records are Zeek connections to the proxy and lack corresponding proxy CONNECT records that would reveal the external host.
The recurring-flow records do not provide process attribution, so they cannot confirm whether an approved updater or another process initiated them.
The available records do not expose the contents or purpose of the encrypted traffic.
claims_not_established: The external destination, URL, or service contacted by the recurring connections.
Whether ChartMate Imaging was installed or running on WS-BCARTER-01 during these connections.
Whether the connections transferred sensitive data or represented command-and-control activity.
Whether the periodic activity was authorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy CONNECT and TLS inspection records matched to each recurring connection, including destination host and URL where available.
Endpoint process-to-network telemetry for the recurring connection times.
Endpoint inventory and execution evidence for cmupdate.exe, including file path, signature, hash, and execution times.
Relevant DNS, TLS certificate, and proxy tunnel metadata to corroborate the destination and identify the service.
unrelated_findings: At 13:37:15 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 had an SMB connection to DC-HD-01 and a machine-account network logon. This is separate from the alerted proxy activity and may merit review against expected workstation access patterns. (T005-00141, T005-00145)
